From my heart

A letter for you 💌

Not a perfect speech. Just my heart, trying to say what you mean to me.

My Priya, my baby, my bubu,

Sometimes I wish I could put all my feelings into your hands so you could understand how much you mean to me. You are not just someone I love; you are someone whose little smile, silly expressions, voice, and presence have become part of my favourite memories.

We have had beautiful moments, and we have had difficult ones too. I know love isn't only about saying the right words or remembering the good days. It's also about listening, learning, being careful with each other's hearts, and showing through our actions that this relationship matters.

I don't expect every day to feel like a movie, and I never want you to feel pressured to prove your love to me. I want us to feel safe with each other, to laugh at our silly things, to speak honestly, and to rebuild anything that needs time—with patience and care.

If I could choose one thing, it would be to keep making little memories with you: random pictures, long conversations, silly filters, hugs that last a little longer, and ordinary days that become special just because we're together.

You will always be my Shizuka, and I'll keep trying to be your Doraemon—not just in cute words, but in the way I care for you. Thank you for being part of my life. I love you, Priya. ❤️

Always yours,
Doraemon 💙
If you are reading this while missing me, imagine me holding your hand and reminding you that you don't have to be okay every second. Take a breath, baby. Somewhere, your Doraemon is thinking about you and hoping you feel loved. One day at a time, one memory at a time. ♡
